title: The Elephant Man
plotSummary: In Victorian London, the surgeon Frederick Treves finds Joseph Merrick, a severely deformed man exhibited as a freak-show attraction, and brings him to the London Hospital. Merrick, thought to be an imbecile, turns out to be intelligent and gentle, and becomes a celebrity of high society while his former keeper schemes to get him back.

title: Dune
plotSummary: In the year 10,191, the Atreides family takes over the desert planet Arrakis, the only source of the spice melange that makes space travel possible. Betrayed by the rival Harkonnens and the Emperor, young Paul Atreides flees into the desert, where he joins the native Fremen and leads them in revolt.

title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me
plotSummary: A prequel to the television series, the film follows the last seven days in the life of Laura Palmer, a small-town homecoming queen leading a hidden life of drugs and prostitution. She is tormented by the demonic BOB, whose true identity she comes to fear, after an FBI investigation into the murder of a drifter named Teresa Banks.

title: Lost Highway
plotSummary: Saxophonist Fred Madison and his wife Renee receive anonymous videotapes filmed inside their home, and Fred is convicted of her murder. On death row he inexplicably turns into a young mechanic, Pete Dayton, who is released and drawn into an affair with a gangster's girlfriend who looks just like Renee.

title: The Straight Story
plotSummary: Seventy-three-year-old Alvin Straight, whose eyesight is too poor for a driving licence, learns that his estranged brother has had a stroke. He sets off to see him, driving a ride-on lawn mower 240 miles from Iowa to Wisconsin and meeting strangers along the way.

title: Inland Empire
plotSummary: Actress Nikki Grace wins the lead in a Hollywood melodrama, then learns it is a remake of a cursed, unfinished Polish film whose stars were murdered. As she and her character begin to merge, her identity splinters across time and place, from Los Angeles to Łódź.

title: Six Men Getting Sick (Six Times)
studios: Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts
plotSummary: Lynch's first film, made as a painting student: a one-minute animated loop, projected six times onto a sculpted screen of three heads, shows six figures whose stomachs fill with colour before they vomit, while a siren wails.

title: The Alphabet
plotSummary: In a mix of live action and animation, a girl lying in bed is tormented by a nightmare about the letters of the alphabet, which multiply and grow around her while a voice sings an alphabet song, until she vomits blood.

title: The Grandmother
plotSummary: A boy neglected and abused by his animalistic parents plants a seed on his bed and grows himself a grandmother, who gives him the tenderness his parents never have. Made with an American Film Institute grant, it led to Lynch's place at the AFI Conservatory, where he made Eraserhead.

title: The Amputee
plotSummary: A woman who has lost both legs writes a letter, heard in voice-over, while a nurse, played by Lynch, clumsily tends to her stumps. Lynch and Coulson wrote it overnight so he could shoot something on the black-and-white video stock the American Film Institute was testing.

title: The Cowboy and the Frenchman
plotSummary: A slapstick comedy in which a cowboy and his ranch hands come across a Frenchman who arrives laden with baguettes, wine and every other French cliché, and the meeting turns into a party. Lynch made it for The French as Seen by..., a French television series of films commissioned by Le Figaro.

title: Premonitions Following an Evil Deed
plotSummary: Lynch's 55-second contribution to the anthology Lumière and Company, shot in a single take on the Lumière brothers' original Cinématographe. In five shots, police discover a body in a field while a woman at home is gripped by troubled thoughts.

title: Darkened Room
plotSummary: A Japanese woman shows the viewer around her Tokyo apartment, muses on how many bananas the world produces, and says her friend next door is sad. Next door, a young woman sits crying on a sofa when another comes in, says cruel things to her and threatens to tell her "the truth". Lynch first released it on his website.

title: Absurda
plotSummary: Lynch's segment for To Each His Own Cinema, the anthology marking the Cannes Film Festival's 60th anniversary. Four unseen people enter a cinema expecting a film about dancing, but the screen shows only a giant pair of scissors, then images of their friends: Cindy in a pink dress and ballet shoes, and Tom with a bloody face.

title: Lady Blue Shanghai
plotSummary: A promotional film for Dior. A woman returns to her Shanghai hotel room to find a mysterious handbag she has never seen and 1920s music playing, and is drawn into a dreamlike memory of old Shanghai.

title: Idem Paris
plotSummary: A black-and-white documentary about the Idem lithography studio in Paris, where Lynch made his own prints, watching the craftsmen ink stones, run the presses and pull lithographs among the old machines.

title: What Did Jack Do?
plotSummary: In a black-and-white train-station café, a detective, played by Lynch, interrogates Jack, a talking capuchin monkey suspected of murder, who has fallen in love with a chicken named Toototabon.

title: Industrial Symphony No. 1
plotSummary: An avant-garde stage performance with music by Angelo Badalamenti and Julee Cruise, filmed at the Brooklyn Academy of Music in 1989. It opens with Nicolas Cage breaking up with Laura Dern over the phone, then Cruise, as the heartbroken woman's dream self, sings suspended above a dark industrial stage.

title: Rabbits
plotSummary: Three people in rabbit costumes live in a dim living room while it rains outside. Their disjointed conversations are punctuated by a sitcom laugh track. Lynch first released it as an eight-episode series on his website, and later reused the set and some footage in Inland Empire.

title: Duran Duran: Unstaged
plotSummary: Lynch's film of Duran Duran's 2011 concert at the Mayan Theater in Los Angeles, part of the Unstaged series, with the band's performance overlaid with Lynch's own images and objects.
